title: Brane-world scenarios and the missing signatures of large extra dimensions
bottleneck: Models like ADD and Randall-Sundrum confine Standard Model particles to a 3-brane while gravity leaks into large or warped extra dimensions, predicting deviations from Newton's law at sub-millimeter scales and black hole production at colliders. Neither effect has been seen, squeezing the allowed parameter space without ruling the idea out.
why_it_blocks: Brane-world models were a leading route to solving the hierarchy problem geometrically; their progressive exclusion without a decisive test leaves the hierarchy problem stranded between falsified models and untestable ones.
current_state: Torsion-balance experiments confirm Newtonian gravity down to tens of microns and the LHC sees no microscopic black holes, leaving only warped models with high curvature scales still viable. Warped Randall-Sundrum models survive with curvature near the TeV scale, though they trade the hierarchy problem for the stabilization of the extra-dimensional radius.
